scope: Complete ore preparation, merge, GPU masks/readback and final application on retained real terrain; not whole-region generation. Two warmup pairs and seven alternating measured pairs, two CPU workers, no game or full-region benchmark.

geometry_probe.note: Geometry diagnostics only; no mask equivalence or speed claim.

validation.actual_gpu_masks: 2 passed; each checks 26 chunks, replacement chains, exposure, scattered, far/negative coordinates, reuse, forced CPU repair
validation.normal_plan_selector: Final A/B warmup invokes TerrainEngine::plan_ores and compares all ore blocks to baseline
validation.java_metrics: generationMetricsTest passed; rolling window, p95, throughput scope, packet/display checks

measurement_limits: Device timestamps may be absent and overlap host timings; end-to-end host wall time is the performance measure.

Process resources include both variants, fixture, profile, driver and harness. They are not paired memory deltas. The final time command wraps Python, so peak memory footprint is not an authoritative GPU/process-tree peak.
retained_gpu_bytes measures shared reusable ore buffers plus coefficient table. Both variants share capacity; not standalone baseline/candidate memory comparison.
GPU pruning survivor bitmap and exact bounds compared against CPU for the first warmup of each profile/size; every pair compares final blocks.
No whole-generator or MCA throughput improvement is inferred.
